selectionRule.is: trades>=30, PF>1.10, netPnl>0, maxDD<=5%; rank by IS return/maxDD, deterministic configId tie-break.
selectionRule.validation: trades>=10, PF>1, netPnl>0; stress 1.5x netPnl>0; >=3/4 IS subperiods positive; concentration<=60%.
selectionRule.freeze: Maximum five candidates, ranked only by IS among validation-passing configurations, before TEST.
selectionRule.holdout: trades>=10, PF>1, netPnl>0, maxDD<=5%; no reranking or reoptimization after opening.
selectionRule.promotion: New paper validation only, never live and never automatic activation.
